The oldest known lake trout in the Great Lakes was recently documented by researchers at the Michigan Department of Natural Resources.

My colleague Shawn Sitar's lab (MDNR) just sampled the oldest known lake trout from Lake Superior at 62 yrs, as shown in the rings of this otolith cross-section. Excited to start a newly funded project this summer quantifying fish growth-climate responses.
